Players Committee card image of [[Tantive IV (V) (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “May deploy without presence or Force icons. May add 3 pilots and 4 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. Adds one [Light Side] icon here.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/tantiveiv_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8ba25cdb109b5da73d1397712bcc202e4a11ee69 8ba25cd] (7 January 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
